fichas.title: Playgrounds and Playground Equipment
fichas.summary: Guidance for designing varied, changeable playgrounds that meet children's needs, including safety, sunlight, materials, location, age-based provision and accessibility. The page illustrates playground equipment and a playground layout, and lists guideline values for usable area per resident and distance from home.
